AdminAccount.title: AdminAccount
AdminAccount.description: Authorized Alkhaleyah admin user record keyed by Firebase Auth UID.

email.description: Email address of the admin account.

addedBy.description: UID of the owner admin who granted access.

OrderRecord.title: OrderRecord
OrderRecord.description: Publicly trackable non-PII status summary for an Alkhaleyah order or product inquiry.

kind.description: Whether the submission originated from the inquiry form or shopping cart.

orderType.description: Personal home customer or wholesale trade inquiry.

customerName.description: Display name shown on order tracking status.

itemsSummary.description: List of ordered varieties, pack sizes, and quantities.

isSample.description: Optional flag marking built-in demo records.

OrderContactPii.title: OrderContactPii
OrderContactPii.description: Admin-only private contact details and delivery notes for an order.

notes.description: Customer delivery instructions or inquiry notes.

CatalogOverride.title: CatalogOverride
CatalogOverride.description: Admin-managed product variety price, pack variant, visibility, or custom item definition.

isActive.description: Whether this product variety is currently visible in the storefront.

imageUrl.description: Primary or legacy single custom product image.

imageUrls.description: Ordered list of up to 6 custom product images for dynamic sliding display.

variants.description: Pack size variants and EGP prices (up to 10 variants).

updatedBy.description: UID of admin who updated the catalog entry.

StoreSettings.title: StoreSettings
StoreSettings.description: Public storefront operational settings editable by admins.

supportPhone.description: Formatted support phone number displayed in storefront contact details.

announcementEn.description: Top announcement bar text in English.

announcementAr.description: Top announcement bar text in Arabic.

updatedBy.description: UID of admin who saved settings.

AdminNotification.title: AdminNotification
AdminNotification.description: Real-time notification feed event delivered to the Alkhaleyah admin dashboard for new orders, inquiries, status updates, catalog edits, and setting changes.

id.description: Notification identifier matching the Firestore document ID.

type.description: Event category that triggered the notification.

targetTab.description: Admin dashboard tab linked to this notification.

referenceId.description: Associated order reference ID or entity key.

actor.description: Customer display name or admin email who triggered the event.

isRead.description: Whether the notification has been acknowledged in the admin dashboard.

AdminNotificationConfig.title: AdminNotificationConfig
AdminNotificationConfig.description: Admin-only notification channel and alert preferences.

soundEnabled.description: Play an audible chime in the admin dashboard when a new alert arrives.

desktopAlertsEnabled.description: Show browser desktop notifications when permitted.

notifyOnNewOrder.description: Send alerts for new customer orders and product inquiries.

notifyOnStatusChange.description: Log and notify when order fulfillment status is updated.

notifyOnCatalogUpdate.description: Log and notify when catalog items, prices, or photos are changed.

notifyOnSettingsUpdate.description: Log and notify when storefront or team settings are saved.

notifyEmail.description: Admin email address for email alert routing.

ntfyTopic.description: Optional ntfy.sh topic channel name for mobile/desktop push alerts.

webhookUrl.description: Optional HTTPS Slack or Discord webhook URL for real-time team alerts.

updatedBy.description: UID of admin who updated notification settings.

CategoryImageOverride.title: CategoryImageOverride
CategoryImageOverride.description: Admin-managed cover image override for a storefront product category.

categorySlug.description: Category slug matching the document ID.

imageUrl.description: Primary category cover image (empty for default, preset:<id>, https:// URL, or compressed image data URI).

imageUrls.description: Ordered list of up to 6 category cover images for dynamic sliding display.

updatedBy.description: UID of admin who updated the category picture.

/orders/{orderId}.description: Trackable order and inquiry progress summaries indexed by reference ID.

/orders/{orderId}/private/contact.description: Admin-only private customer contact information for each order.

/adminNotifications/{notificationId}.description: Admin-only real-time notification feed for new orders and dashboard updates.

/adminConfig/{configId}.description: Admin-only private notification preferences and push channel configuration.

/catalogOverrides/{productKey}.description: Live admin product catalog overrides and custom varieties.

/categoryImages/{categorySlug}.description: Live admin category cover picture overrides.

/storeSettings/{settingId}.description: Global storefront configuration document (document ID: public).
